name: @adhisang/minecraft-modding-mcp

tools.name: list-versions
tools.description: List available Minecraft versions from Mojang manifest and locally cached version jars. Expert tool: prefer the entry tools (inspect-minecraft, analyze-symbol, compare-minecraft, analyze-mod, validate-project) first.

tools.name: inspect-minecraft
tools.description: Top-level workflow tool for version discovery, artifact resolution, class inspection, source search, file reads, and file listings. Workspace subject.focus is a structured class/file/search object, never a string; task=auto dispatches from subject.kind and focus.kind.

task.description: Workflow task. auto dispatches only from subject.kind and workspace focus.kind; it is not a natural-language planner.

artifact.description: Optional explicit artifact override; otherwise resolve it from the workspace.

anyOf.description: Class focus object: {"kind":"class","className":"net.minecraft.world.item.Item"}. task=auto dispatches it to class-overview; select class-source or class-members explicitly when needed.

artifact.description: Optional explicit artifact override; otherwise resolve it from the workspace.

anyOf.description: File focus object: {"kind":"file","filePath":"net/minecraft/world/item/Item.java"}. task=auto dispatches it to file.

query.description: Source, symbol, or path query to search for.

artifact.description: Optional explicit artifact override; otherwise resolve it from the workspace.

anyOf.description: Search focus object: {"kind":"search","query":"CreativeModeTab"}. task=auto dispatches it to search.

focus.description: Structured workspace focus. Object, not string. Choose {kind:"class",className}, {kind:"file",filePath}, or {kind:"search",query}.

anyOf.description: Workspace subject. Resolves Minecraft artifact context from projectPath; add a structured focus object for class, file, or search work.

subject.description: Structured inspection subject. Use kind=workspace with a structured focus object when the workspace should resolve artifact context.

tools.name: analyze-symbol
tools.description: Top-level workflow tool for symbol existence, mapping, lifecycle, workspace analysis, and API overview. subject.kind='symbol' auto-detects class/field/method from the selector.

kind.description: Symbol kind. Use 'symbol' to auto-detect from the selector: owner+descriptor => method, owner only => field, otherwise => class. The inferred kind is reported as a warning. For task=api-overview the inferred kind must be class.

version.description: Point-in-time MC version for task=exists/map/exact-map/workspace/api-overview. For task=lifecycle it is accepted as a back-compat alias for toVersion (range end).

fromVersion.description: task=lifecycle only: range start (oldest) version; defaults to the oldest version in the manifest.

toVersion.description: task=lifecycle only: range end (newest) version; takes precedence over version. Defaults to latest.

maxVersions.description: task=lifecycle only: cap on scanned versions (service default 120, max 400).

includeTimeline.description: task=lifecycle only: include per-version timeline entries.

includeSnapshots.description: task=lifecycle only: include snapshot versions in the scan.

tools.name: compare-minecraft
tools.description: Top-level workflow tool for version comparisons, class diffs, registry diffs, and migration overviews.

tools.name: analyze-mod
tools.description: Top-level workflow tool for mod metadata inspection, decompile/search flows, class source, bytecode-only class member reads, and safe remap previews/applies.

tools.name: validate-project
tools.description: Top-level workflow tool for project summary, direct mixin validation, and access widener/access transformer validation.

reportMode.description: Mixin report shape forwarded to validate-mixin. Default 'summary-first'; pass 'full' (or explain=true) for per-result resolvedMembers/toolHealth/resolutionTrace.

tools.name: manage-cache
tools.description: Top-level workflow tool for cache summaries, listing, verification, previewed mutation, and explicit apply operations.

tools.name: verify-mixin-target
tools.description: Single-call probe: does this target owner / member exist and which @Shadow / @Accessor / @Invoker should the mixin use? Reuses target.kind workspace/version/coordinate/dependency/jar.

descriptor.description: Optional JVM method descriptor, e.g. "()V". Empty/whitespace strings are treated as omitted.
Optional JVM field descriptor, e.g. "I". Empty/whitespace strings are treated as omitted.

mixinMemberName.description: Caller-authored mixin member name; drives @Accessor/@Invoker advice when the target is private.

autoRemap.description: Translate owner+member via find-mapping when mapping differs from the artifact namespace (requires a version-based target).

projectPath.description: Workspace root path for target.kind=workspace and Loom cache assistance.

gradleUserHome.description: Gradle user home for Loom cache lookups (overrides GRADLE_USER_HOME).

version.description: Explicit version; omit and set versionFromProject to resolve it from the workspace.

versionFromProject.description: Resolve the version from the project's gradle.properties / gradle cache (requires projectPath).

target.description: Object, not string. e.g. {"kind":"version","value":"1.21.10"}, {"kind":"workspace"}, or to inspect a loader/Fabric dependency like vanilla: {"kind":"dependency","group":"net.fabricmc.fabric-api","name":"fabric-api","versionFromProject":true} (needs projectPath) or with an explicit "version".

scope.description: vanilla = Mojang client jar only; merged = merged runtime discovery; loader = loader-transformed runtime jars.

preferProjectVersion.description: Detect MC version from gradle.properties and override target.value

tools.name: batch-class-source
tools.description: Batch get-class-source for many classes sharing one resolved artifact; returns per-entry status plus aggregate summary. Not read-only: per-entry outputFile writes to disk.

version.description: Explicit version; omit and set versionFromProject to resolve it from the workspace.

versionFromProject.description: Resolve the version from the project's gradle.properties / gradle cache (requires projectPath).

target.description: Same shape as resolve-artifact target (incl. {"kind":"dependency",...} to read a Fabric/loader dependency class like vanilla), plus {"kind":"artifact","artifactId":"..."} to reuse a resolved artifact. Object, not string.

gradleUserHome.description: Gradle user home for Loom cache lookups (overrides GRADLE_USER_HOME).

detail.description: summary = terse (drops diagnostics/empties, slims candidates); standard = keeps fields, drops heavy diagnostics; full = everything.

include.description: Field groups to include regardless of detail, e.g. ["provenance"].

entries.description: 1..50 entries; each shares the resolved target artifact.

tools.name: batch-class-members
tools.description: Batch get-class-members for many classes sharing one resolved artifact; returns per-entry status plus aggregate summary.

projection.description: Per-member field projection: "names" (member name only), "signatures" (name + javaSignature, no jvmDescriptor), or "full" (default; complete member shape). Use "names"/"signatures" to cut response tokens for existence/signature checks.

include.description: Field groups to include regardless of detail, e.g. ["provenance"].

memberPattern.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on member names. Use "|" for OR alternatives, e.g. "getStateForPlacement|canSurvive|setPlacedBy" (each token is matched as a substring, not a regex).

target.description: Only kind="version" or kind="workspace"; other kinds carry library versions, not MC versions.

tools.name: search-class-source
tools.description: Search indexed class source files for one artifact with symbol/text/path intent and compact hit output. Decompiled text can differ from hand-written code (`final` parameters, `@Nullable` between modifiers and type, wrapped declarations), so search for a method by its name or with intent `symbol`, not by its full declaration. Expert tool: prefer the entry tools (inspect-minecraft, analyze-symbol, compare-minecraft, analyze-mod, validate-project) first.
